system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a GCP Deployment Manager YAML template provisioning a Compute Engine VM instance (e2-medium, Ubuntu 22.04) in us-central1 for a development workload.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Create a GCP Deployment Manager YAML template provisioning a Compute Engine VM instance (e2-medium, Ubuntu 22.04) in us-central1 for a development workload.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: dev-network
  type: compute.v1.network
  properties:
    autoCreateSubnetworks: false

- name: dev-subnet
  type: compute.v1.subnetwork
  properties:
    region: us-central1
    network: $(ref.dev-network.selfLink)
    ipCidrRange: 10.10.0.0/24
    privateIpGoogleAccess: true

- name: fw-allow-iap-ssh
  type: compute.v1.firewall
  properties:
    network: $(ref.dev-network.selfLink)
    direction: INGRESS
    priority: 1000
    targetTags:
    - allow-iap-ssh
    sourceRanges:
    - 35.235.240.0/20
    allowed:
    - IPProtocol: tcp
      ports:
      - "22"
    logConfig:
      enable: true
      metadata: INCLUDE_ALL_METADATA

- name: nat-router-us-central1
  type: compute.v1.router
  properties:
    region: us-central1
    network: $(ref.dev-network.selfLink)
    bgp:
      asn: 64514
    nats:
    - name: nat-us-central1
      natIpAllocateOption: AUTO_ONLY
      sourceSubnetworkIpRangesToNat: LIST_OF_SUBNETWORKS
      subnetworks:
      - name: $(ref.dev-subnet.selfLink)
        sourceIpRangesToNat:
        - ALL_IP_RANGES

- name: dev-vm-sa
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.serviceAccounts
  properties:
    parent: projects/$(project)
    accountId: dev-vm-sa
    serviceAccount:
      displayName: Dev VM Service Account

- name: sa-log-writer-binding
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: $(project)
    role: roles/logging.logWriter
    member: serviceAccount:$(ref.dev-vm-sa.email)

- name: sa-metric-writer-binding
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: $(project)
    role: roles/monitoring.metricWriter
    member: serviceAccount:$(ref.dev-vm-sa.email)

- name: dev-vm
  type: compute.v1.instance
  properties:
    zone: us-central1-a
    machineType: zones/us-central1-a/machineTypes/e2-medium
    canIpForward: false
    deletionProtection: false
    labels:
      env: dev
    tags:
      items:
      - allow-iap-ssh
    shieldedInstanceConfig:
      enableSecureBoot: true
      enableVtpm: true
      enableIntegrityMonitoring: true
    scheduling:
      automaticRestart: true
      onHostMaintenance: MIGRATE
      provisioningModel: STANDARD
    serviceAccounts:
    - email: $(ref.dev-vm-sa.email)
      scopes:
      - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/logging.write
      - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/monitoring.write
    disks:
    - deviceName: boot
      type: PERSISTENT
      boot: true
      autoDelete: true
      initializeParams:
        diskSizeGb: 50
        diskType: pd-balanced
        sourceImage: projects/ubuntu-os-cloud/global/images/family/ubuntu-2204-lts
    networkInterfaces:
    - subnetwork: $(ref.dev-subnet.selfLink)
    metadata:
      items:
      - key: enable-oslogin
        value: "TRUE"
      - key: block-project-ssh-keys
        value: "TRUE"
      - key: serial-port-enable
        value: "0"

outputs:
- name: instanceSelfLink
  value: $(ref.dev-vm.selfLink)
- name: instanceInternalIP
  value: $(ref.dev-vm.networkInterfaces[0].networkIP)
- name: subnetworkSelfLink
  value: $(ref.dev-subnet.selfLink)
- name: natRouterSelfLink
  value: $(ref.nat-router-us-central1.selfLink)
